# self evidence

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:evidenceSELF`](gmeow-evidenceSELF.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/evidenceSELF>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/evidence`](../../slices/evidence.md)

Evidence originating from the subject of the claim itself — a self-assertion, self-published biography, or press release. High authority for the subject's own standpoint ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), but low warrant for third-party verification.
